posts.title: Water Use in Hydrogen Production
posts.description: 31/10/26 TL&DR Summary: green hydrogen’s water use is not a meaningful environmental impact. Green hydrogen, if made truly green, may actually reduce water use when it replaces black (fossil derived) hydrogen for use as a chemical.
